description: The Fairy Dogmother in Back Cove offers one-on-one grooming appointments in a cage-free, spacious cottage setting that accommodates dogs of all sizes, including giant breeds. Operating since 2015, the salon is owned by Arielle Derice Poland and staffed by groomer Jenn Chiu, who holds multiple certifications including Professional Pet Grooming Certification and Brachycephalic Breed Safety. The team regularly attends grooming shows and expos across the U.S. and offers creative styling options, including pet-safe hair color upon request. Multiple groomers often collaborate on each appointment to ensure the dog's comfort, with same-day pickup available.
